audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer gave Lux levels 1-2 and called every row from 6 onward Skill; content win[] and the packet levelChart say Skill through 4-5 and Lissandra from 6.
audit.why: Lux out-ranges you at 1175 but has no dash and Light Binding is 10s flat at every rank — the early rows are a dodge race, and from 6 a point-and-click Frozen Tomb on an immobile mage is a kill, not a coin flip. The 54.08% win rate over 4,325 games agrees with the content layer.
audit.corrected: Full sides realigned to Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra with the whys rewritten to argue each row.

audit.why: Level 6 Frozen Tomb, first item punishing her 10s Q windows, and her late Zhonya's answer are all correctly placed in the content spikes.
audit.corrected: Left as-is; phases[5].why now names the 10s Light Binding window that creates the timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither of the two interactions that decide commits was on the page: Prismatic Barrier eating the burst you spend a 120-second ultimate to set up, and Illumination's auto detonation being the real damage tell.
audit.why: Prismatic Barrier is 12s down to 10s from 1150 and shields on the way out and back; Illumination charges on any damaging spell and pops on her next auto, so the auto wind-up — not the spell cast — is the step-back cue. Light Binding is 10s flat and can be blocked by a minion.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now covers forcing the barrier out; breakdown.early carries the Illumination tell; breakdown.cooldowns carries every real number.

audit.whatIsWrong: 20 misgendered fields, two bodies pasted from tradeGood/tradeBad, and a cooldowns field with no digit.
